notes:
Variants section of the use-case dialog, with the **structured variant editor** (CHR-1103; replaces the "Other overrides (JSON)" textarea). Same dialog as `usecases-edit-dialog`; the section always sits last in the body, after Steps. + Variant appends a new empty variant, scrolls to it and focuses its Title (`usecases-edit-dialog-variant-empty`).

**Drawing (not UI):** the dialog is stretched to show the whole first variant; the real dialog keeps its 836px height and the body scrolls. Title, status, story, inputs, outputs and steps sit above, as in `usecases-edit-dialog`.

**Per variant (bordered box, one per variant), top to bottom:**
1. Title | ID (mono; derived from the title until edited, read-only once saved) | remove (×). Description (one line).
2. **Applies when** — unchanged (`uc-value-toggle` per dimension value).
3. **Overrides** · "what you do not override comes from the base": a `110px | 1fr` grid with Trigger, Goal, Outcome, Personas, Inputs, Outputs. Inherited = `uc-inherited` ("From base" + the base value in one line + **Override**). Override swaps the cell for the field's editor prefilled with the base value, plus **Use base** (drops the key, sends `null`): Trigger/Goal/Outcome = textarea (drawn: Outcome); Personas = chips + Add persona; Inputs/Outputs = the base form's rows (data object select, from/to, example) + "+ Input"/"+ Output" (drawn in `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-invalid`). Inputs and outputs replace the base list wholesale (spec §4), so an override starts as a copy of the base rows. Personas inherited after actor swaps shows the result: "Dex (Dana, swapped below)".
4. **Actor swaps** · "applied once to the inherited base steps, before the step changes; not chained": rows `uc-select` from → `arrow_forward` → `uc-select` to, remove (×); "+ Actor swap". Options: System + personas, plain names. A from-persona can appear once; the to-select may not equal its from (that option is disabled). Writes the variant `actors` map (spec §4, CHR-1102).
5. **Step changes** · "applied in order, top to bottom; drag a handle to reorder": one `uc-step-op` row per op (pattern; Replace / Insert after / Remove / Append). The step select lists the flow as it stands at that change ("<n> · <action>": base steps after the actor swaps, then the steps added by earlier changes), so an Insert after can point at a step added above it. Replace prefills the body from that step; changing the step of a Replace asks nothing and keeps typed values. Remove shows the struck base step with `uc-diff-badge removed` and has no body. Rows reorder with the same handle, drag and keyboard as the base steps (`usecases-edit-dialog-step-drag` / `-step-keyboard`). "+ Step change" adds a Replace row with the step select on its placeholder "Step…" and focuses the op select.

Colour language = the variant diff on `usecases-detail-variant`: Replace amber, Insert after / Append green, Remove dashed red.

**Save rule.** Errors (block Save, first one in the footer, danger): "Variant N needs a title."; "Variant "<title>" needs a condition (when)."; "Variant "<title>", change N: <id> is already a step in this flow." (spec §6 shape error); "Variant "<title>", change N: pick the step it changes."; "Variant "<title>", change N: the step needs an action."; overridden inputs/outputs follow the base rules (at least one row, each with an example). Warnings (never block, amber, counted in the footer): a change pointing at a step that is not in the flow at that point (`variant_step_missing`), an unknown persona in a swap. The old "the overrides are not a JSON object" error is gone.

Flows: close / Cancel → `usecases-detail`; Save → `usecases-detail-variant`; + Variant → `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-empty`.
